_comment: South Korea Desk - production manifest, activated by the owner through
One source: Korea Policy Briefing republications explicitly labeled as
MND (A00005) releases. access_method is manual: the Daily never fetches
the portal. The private collector (ipr-source-evidence-private) keeps
captures, HWPX and photographs; records reach `articles` only through the
source-pinned bridge (core/korea_corpus_bridge.py) for identities in the
public KOGL release index. DAPA stays metadata-only and is not a source
here. Tier B reflects republication; cadence thresholds remain unset.

institutions.notes: Government portal that republishes ministry press releases. Publisher of record for this source, not its issuer.

institutions.display_name: South Korea Ministry of National Defense
institutions.notes: Original issuer of the releases this desk carries.

sources.notes: Manual in this repository: collected once daily by the private, robots-compliant collector; admitted to the corpus only through the source-pinned bridge for KOGL Type 1 releases in research/korea_published_original_texts. The frozen October baseline, the editor-reviewed English releases and the research hold are never bridged. Portal posting date is preserved; dates inside the document stay original text. Not direct MND-site retrieval, not a complete MND wire, not independent corroboration.
